title: Prior-work faithful applicability and comparator audit review

audited_works.name: LipCache

primary_source.title: LipCache: A Local Inference Proxy with Certified Caching for Edge Image Classification Service

guarantee_target.statement: Certificate guarantees decision invariance of the edge GuardNet proxy only.
guarantee_target.exact_quote_remark_5_2: theoretical certificate of LipCache is on the GuardNet side, not on the MainNet side
guarantee_target.project_reference_target_match: FAIL: Project requires certified decision preservation of frozen SmallCNN1D reference, not an external proxy.

workload_and_data_domain.streaming_applicability: UNVERIFIED: Section 7.1 acknowledges temporal redundancy, concept drift, and consecutive-frame reuse in streaming as future work.

adaptation_prerequisites: Requires training a separate 1D Lipschitz-bounded GuardNet proxy network.
Requires calibration of empirical GuardNet-MainNet agreement thresholds.
Requires relaxing the formal guarantee from exact reference preservation to heuristic proxy agreement.
reasons: Training a new GuardNet proxy violates the frozen reference protocol (W4-001/002).
GuardNet certificate does not transfer to the frozen SmallCNN1D MainNet.
Image speedup (up to 1.65x) cannot be soundly transferred to 1D sensor time-series with 50% temporal overlap.

audited_works.name: StreamiNNC

primary_source.title: Don't Think It Twice: Efficient Inference on Streaming Data via Incremental CNN Computation

guarantee_target.statement: Algebraically exact feature map reuse for sliding window CNN inference.

adaptation_prerequisites: Handling zero-padding border distortion in multi-layer convolutions.
Tensors must maintain unpadded feature columns across temporal window shifts.
audited_works.relationship_to_ecdr: Directly motivated project method M03 (Exact incremental computation, W4-019..W4-021).
reasons: Paper implementation uses a different code base and hardware abstraction.
Conceptual principles are already absorbed into ECDR M03, which is evaluated natively on SmallCNN1D.
Excluded from external comparator ranking to prevent duplicate or fabricated benchmarks.

audited_works.name: TinyDejaVu

primary_source.title: TinyDejaVu: Smaller RAM and Faster Inference with Neural Networks on MCUs for Sensor Data Streams

guarantee_target.statement: SRAM reduction and execution acceleration on microcontrollers via circular activation buffering.

workload_and_data_domain.data_structure: Real-time streaming samples on bare-metal MCU

adaptation_prerequisites: Low-level memory management using CMSIS-NN or bare-metal C circular buffers.
Target platform must have extreme memory constraints (SRAM < 256KB).
reasons: Incompatible runtime target: ECDR evaluates float32 CPU PyTorch on Linux x86_64, whereas TinyDejaVu targets microcontroller SRAM optimization.

scientific_hypothesis_disposition.statement: ECDR beats LipCache in practice on streaming HAPT.
scientific_hypothesis_disposition.scientific_rationale: Direct head-to-head benchmarking against LipCache is not feasible within the frozen reference protocol. LipCache certificates apply only to the GuardNet proxy and its evaluation is restricted to i.i.d. image classification without consecutive streaming overlap. Fabricating an artificial HAPT LipCache proxy would violate the frozen scope without providing a mathematically faithful comparator. Therefore, no claim of superiority over LipCache can be established.
